dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' shaped structures along the upper dorsal-lateral region exhibit sharp, high-contrast white perimeters surrounding darker interior cores. The gradient transition from the dark exterior coat to the white ring-edge is immediate, while the interior-facing edge of the rings shows a softer transition toward the central dark pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated on the posterior-most visible portion of the flank. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as irregular, solid-color blobs with higher core pixel concentration than the more anteriorly located annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated, near-linear triangular configuration along the longitudinal axis. This configuration, when linked to the centroid of the densest posterior blob cluster, creates a trapezoidal spatial relationship.
